translations.web: The priests shall not eat of anything that dies of itself, or is torn, whether it is bird or animal.
translations.bsb: The priests may not eat any bird or animal found dead or torn by wild beasts.
translations.kjv: The priests shall not eat of any thing that is dead of itself, or torn, whether it be fowl or beast.
translations.asv: The priests shall not eat of anything that dieth of itself, or is torn, whether it be bird or beast.
